chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from al-ʿAlāʾ, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Abā Jaʿfar عليه السلام about the pebbles-throwing ritual, and he said: Do not throw the jamarāt except while you are in a state of taharah (ritual purity).

key_terms.الْجِمَارِ: the jamarāt, the ritual stone-pillars pelted during hajj
key_terms.تَرْمِ: to throw or cast, referring here to the ritual pelting
key_terms.سَأَلْتُ: I asked, introducing the inquiry to the Imam
key_terms.فَقَالَ: then he said, introducing the Imam’s ruling

ai.seo_question: Is taharah required when throwing the jamarāt during hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal instruction regarding the rite of throwing the jamarāt during hajj. Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام states that one should not perform this rite except while in a state of taharah (ritual purity), indicating the importance of purity in acts of worship.
